summary: You have a solid, consistent profile across all your subjects, sitting in the low-to-mid 60s everywhere with no dramatic weak spots. Two competencies are flagged as gaps and are the priority for focused study: Object-Oriented Design and Implementation (isolated gap, 62.7% in CSE1OOF) and Data Structures and Algorithms (persistent but stable gap, 63.7% across CSE1OOF and CSE2ALG). Your project and communication work in CSE3CAP is stronger, so the strategy is to lift the design and implementation fundamentals while building on the reporting strengths you already show.

priorities.evidence: This is an isolated gap at 62.7% in CSE1OOF. Your CSE1OOF:Test (60.0%) and CSE1OOF:Central examination (62.0%) were your lowest results, and both markers noted developing consistency on CSE1OOF:SILO1 (analysis/design/implementation with object-oriented modelling) and on object-oriented design of programs for real-life problems. The exam feedback specifically asked you to explain design and implementation decisions with stronger evidence.
priorities.actions: Re-open the marker feedback on CSE1OOF:Central examination and CSE1OOF:Test and list each point flagged for CSE1OOF:SILO1. Re-attempt the design/modelling questions from the exam, this time writing a short justification for every class and method choice. Redo one CSE1OOF:Practical demonstration exercise tied to CSE1OOF:SILO4, building a small real-life program end to end and adding code reuse (CSE1OOF:SILO3) to show you can reduce duplication.

priorities.evidence: This is a persistent but stable gap at 63.7%, seen in both CSE1OOF (62.7%) and CSE2ALG (64.1%). Your CSE2ALG:Assignment (63.0%) and CSE2ALG:Central examination (64.0%) were flagged as developing on implementing structures in Java (CSE2ALG:SILO3), comparing algorithms (CSE2ALG:SILO4) and evaluating solutions with performance measures (CSE2ALG:SILO5), while your CSE2ALG:Test (66.0%) showed a sound grasp of identifying structures and algorithms (CSE2ALG:SILO2).
priorities.actions: Revisit the CSE2ALG:Central examination feedback and re-attempt questions requiring you to compare two data structures or algorithms and justify a choice (CSE2ALG:SILO4). For CSE2ALG:SILO5, re-do a CSE2ALG:Assignment task and add explicit performance measurements (timing or complexity analysis) with a written evaluation. Reinforce the CSE1OOF:SILO2 link by practising abstract data type implementations that encapsulate data to localise change.

priorities.evidence: This competency is developing at 65.0% in CSE3CAP. Your CSE3CAP:Assignment: Final written Project Report (64.0%) was flagged as developing on industry standard technical solutions (CSE3CAP:SILO2), while your CSE3CAP:Assignment: Sprint Project management reports (66.0%) showed a sound grasp of the same theme, so the difference is in the written report.
priorities.actions: Compare the marker comments on your CSE3CAP:Assignment: Final written Project Report against the stronger CSE3CAP:Assignment: Sprint Project management reports and identify where the report fell short of industry standards (CSE3CAP:SILO2). Revise one section of the report to reference specific industry practices or standards explicitly and add clearer technical reasoning as the feedback requested.
